requirements.title: A BACKSPACE statement has a unit-number form or position-spec-list form
requirements.definition: A backspace-stmt is BACKSPACE file-unit-number or BACKSPACE with a parenthesized position-spec-list.

pending.backspace-unit-number-form: Compile/run a conforming `BACKSPACE u` after writing and reading a known named sequential file; assert the following read returns the preceding record.
pending.backspace-position-spec-list-form: Compile/run `BACKSPACE (UNIT=u, IOSTAT=ios)` in the same named-file control; the syntax negative removes only the parentheses or list.

requirements.title: File-positioning statements do not refer to direct access, and selected modes restrict BACKSPACE and ENDFILE
requirements.definition: A unit connected for direct access shall not be referred to by BACKSPACE, ENDFILE, or REWIND; a unit connected for unformatted stream access shall not be referred to by BACKSPACE; a unit connected with ACTION=READ shall not be referred to by ENDFILE.

pending.direct-access-backspace-prohibited: Negative source-control opens a named direct-access file and changes only the statement from a conforming direct READ/WRITE control to BACKSPACE; no portable diagnostic is required for this unnumbered restriction.
pending.direct-access-endfile-prohibited: Negative source-control opens a named direct-access file and changes only the statement to ENDFILE; no portable diagnostic is required.
pending.direct-access-rewind-prohibited: Negative source-control opens a named direct-access file and changes only the statement to REWIND; no portable diagnostic is required.
pending.unformatted-stream-backspace-prohibited: Negative source-control opens a named unformatted stream file and changes only the statement to BACKSPACE; no portable diagnostic is required.
pending.action-read-endfile-prohibited: Negative source-control opens a named sequential file with ACTION=READ and changes only the statement to ENDFILE; no portable diagnostic is required.

requirements.title: A file positioning statement waits for all pending asynchronous transfers on its unit
requirements.definition: Execution of a file positioning statement performs a wait operation for all pending asynchronous data transfer operations for the specified unit.

accounting.rationale: Records access/action restrictions on BACKSPACE, ENDFILE, and REWIND.
Cross-reference to status specifier descriptions in 12.11.
File positioning statements wait for all pending asynchronous transfers on the unit.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.5-12.9: termination of data transfer, WAIT, BACKSPACE, ENDFILE, REWIND and FLUSH (batch164). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds. Round 1 found the portable WAIT no-operation cases missing - WAIT with ID=0 (explicitly permitted by 12.7.2 p3) and with ID= omitted on an asynchronous connection with nothing pending must succeed with IOSTAT zero - and an ENDFILE position plan that used REWIND, destroying the state under test; ENDFILE is now observed by the BACKSPACE that 12.8.3 p2 requires before the next transfer, after which a READ must report IOSTAT_END. Seventeen numbered rules were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
